summary: The base of all networked things, including players, horses, NPCs, dogs, props, stashes and markers. new Entity(id) returns the existing object with that network id. It never spawns anything, and it throws for an unknown id.

dimension.summary: The dimension the entity is in, an unsigned 32-bit number. Entities see each other only in the same dimension, and 4294967295 (World.SHARED_DIMENSION) is the shared one.
dimension.exampleLua:
-- client
local Entity, LocalPlayer = kcds.players.Entity, kcds.players.LocalPlayer

if Entity.new(id).dimension == (LocalPlayer and LocalPlayer.dimension) then
  print("in my dimension")
end

position.summary: The entity's location in world coordinates.

id.summary: The network id, the same on the server and in all players' games.

state.summary: The entity's shared state, for players, horses and NPCs.
